stable.notes: Updates moved to the top of the panel. The check used to be the last thing under everything else, so asking whether you were current meant scrolling to the bottom. The first card now answers it on every open: your version when you are current, an install offer when you are not, and the manual check in both states. Search also follows you all the way down — an archived chat now has its own find bar, seeded with the term that got you there, with a match count, next and previous, and matched turns highlighted in place, so a chat with forty-six mentions takes one keystroke to walk rather than a scroll. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
